sources.title: Uploading and copying objects using multipart upload in Amazon S3
sources.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
sources.locator: ‘Initiate’, ‘Parts upload’, ‘Multipart upload completion’, ‘Multipart upload listings’, and ‘Checksums with multipart upload operations’; displayed lines 28–69 and 72.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Initiation gives upload ID and takes object metadata; completion uses part numbers/ETags in order; ETag not necessarily MD5; upload parts remain stored/billed until complete/abort; ListParts paginates at 1,000 and is not the completion manifest; checksum MPU requires consecutive part numbers from 1; full-object checksum mismatch is BadDigest.
sources.applicability: AWS operation lifecycle and checksum behavior. Check matching endpoint semantics before implementation.

critic_review.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
critic_review.locator: Lines 25–67, 83–91, and checksum header/type table lines 168–176.
critic_review.observed_operation: AWS S3 multipart lifecycle, completion, checksums and checksum types
critic_review.governing_condition_default_exception: Tracks upload IDs and own part/ETag manifest; listings omit unfinished parts; ETag not necessarily MD5; full-object checksum mismatch yields BadDigest; checksum uploads require consecutive part numbers; full-object CRC algorithms are distinct from composite SHA-family algorithms.
critic_review.applicability: AWS behavior only; archive operation/header profile needs owner confirmation.

reviser_recheck.review_status: independently rechecked against official AWS documentation
reviser_recheck.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
reviser_recheck.locator: Displayed lines 58–68 for checksum semantics and lines 168–176 for the multipart checksum algorithm/type/header matrix, especially rows at 173–176.
reviser_recheck.observed_operation: CreateMultipartUpload, UploadPart, and CompleteMultipartUpload checksum types.
reviser_recheck.governing_condition_default_exception: The table lists CRC64NVME as FULL_OBJECT; CRC32 and CRC32C as FULL_OBJECT; and CRC32, CRC32C, SHA1, SHA256, MD5, XXHASH64, XXHASH3, XXHASH128, and SHA512 as COMPOSITE. Thus SHA256 is documented as COMPOSITE for MPU, not as a whole-object SHA256 digest. The source also says a supplied full-object checksum is checked server-side and mismatch yields BadDigest.

sources.title: Checking object integrity in Amazon S3
sources.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
sources.locator: Overview lines 5–9 and note/verification behavior lines 31–37; multipart checksum table in AWS-03.

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AWS S3 calculates an independent checksum and validates a supplied checksum; precomputed checksums on MPU require full-object checksum type for a full-object claim; composite values are distinct from direct whole-object digest.

sources.title: How to prevent object overwrites with conditional writes
sources.version_or_commit: Current rolling AWS S3 User Guide; no immutable revision displayed.
sources.locator: If-None-Match applicability lines 34–44; response semantics and conditional multipart scenarios lines 93–122.

critic_review.applicability: Optional AWS no-overwrite guard, not archive-provider capability or DB idempotency.

sources.title: Resumable Upload Protocol 1.0.x
sources.locator: Core HEAD/PATCH resume lines 65–99 and 128–143; max size/server negotiation lines 117–123 and 146–168; expiration lines 249–276; checksum extension lines 277–297.
